common_fact.source_url: string | null (null allowed only when value == UNKNOWN)
common_fact.source_type: SEC_FILING | COMPANY_IR | EVENT_FEED | MARKET_DATA | INTERNAL_GUIDE | null (null allowed only when value == UNKNOWN)
common_fact.evidence_kind: FILING | ANNOUNCEMENT | RUMOUR | INTERNAL_POLICY | null (null allowed only when value == UNKNOWN)
common_fact.published_or_as_of_utc: ISO-8601 UTC (Z) | null (null allowed only when value == UNKNOWN)

research_record.next_earnings: common_fact (exact date, or {earliest, latest} range, or UNKNOWN)
research_record.verification_status: PENDING | VERIFIED | INVALID | UNKNOWN (auto-reverts to PENDING whenever checked_at_utc > verified_at_utc)
research_record.verified_by: null only while verified_at_utc is null; otherwise must be "Skeptic" (required for any Skeptic verdict: VERIFIED, INVALID or UNKNOWN)
research_record.valid_until_utc: ISO-8601 UTC; next pre-US-session refresh, max 24h after checked_at_utc, cut to now on material news
research_record.dividend: common_fact {amount, ex_date, payment_date} for the NEXT declared dividend | NOT_YET_DECLARED (pays dividends but next one not declared; last paid in notes) | VERIFIED_NONE | UNKNOWN. A past ex_date is SCHEMA_INVALID.
research_record.schema_version: news-research-v1.7 (per record; must equal file schema_version)

wheel_card.latest_annual_operating_cash_flow: common_fact (amount, currency, fiscal_year_end); must be > 0 for eligibility
wheel_card.paper_universe_eligible: common_fact (true | false | UNKNOWN), matched against the guide's Wheel universe list
wheel_card.wheel_universe: MU, AME, AMD, TSM, NVDA, AVGO, ANET, VRT only (guide p8)
wheel_card.card_valid_until_utc: ISO-8601 UTC; at most card_created_at_utc + 72h (guide p8); event facts still refresh each US day
wheel_card.card_created_at_utc: ISO-8601 UTC; set once when the card is created, never moved by refreshes
wheel_card.ocf_filing_date: common_fact (date of the filing the OCF figure comes from) | UNKNOWN

usable_rule: Runner may use a record for new exposure only when verification_status == VERIFIED, verified_at_utc >= checked_at_utc, and now < valid_until_utc. For Wheel cards, additionally ownership_card_status == VERIFIED and now < card_valid_until_utc. An evidence_kind RUMOUR fact can never satisfy an eligibility fact; it may only add a risk flag. Any UNKNOWN eligibility fact fails the gate.

scout_alert.note: An alert is never a trade signal on its own; News may cut a record's valid_until to now from it.

boolean_rule: FALSE and UNKNOWN are distinct values; UNKNOWN fails every gate.
null_rule: null is permitted only where stated. A known value (not UNKNOWN) with any null source field is SCHEMA_INVALID.
internal_guide_rule: INTERNAL_GUIDE / INTERNAL_POLICY may back only paper_universe_eligible, citing the guide file and its sha256; never a company fact.
